style: Hand-painted cut-out puppet parts for a paper-puppet stop-motion film. Every part is a separate flat card cut from corrugated cardboard: gouache paint with confident ink linework, the cardboard's flutes faintly visible through the paint, and a thin raw kraft-brown cut edge (2-3 px) all round each card. Brass split-pin brads where the template marks them. Shot flat-on and orthographic, soft even light, no cast shadows, no perspective. Pure white background. Cards never touch or overlap. No text, labels, crosses, grid or dashed lines in the output.
template_rules: Use the attached template as the exact layout: paint one card inside each grey ghost shape, the same position, size and orientation, filling the ghost and staying inside its dashed outline. Put a brass brad exactly on every green cross. The red cross marks where the next card pins: it must fall inside this card's rounded end, never on its edge. The 10 cm ruler sets the scale for the whole sheet.

sheets.job: SHEET man.body.front: the body cards facing the viewer. The torso card (the jacket, the elastic hem at the bottom; the hip brads sit just above the hem), both upper arms, both forearms with their cuffs, both thighs (each thigh card's top is a rounded seat that tucks under the hem: there is NO separate pelvis or shorts card), both shins and both feet. Each card ends in a round disc at every brad, so it can turn on the brad without a gap.
